brief:
Israeli settlers have established a new settlement outpost on Palestinian land in Beit Kahil, located north of Hebron, Eye on Palestine reported. The outpost marks another instance of Israeli settlement expansion in the occupied West Bank territory.

Beit Kahil lies in an area of the northern Hebron region where Palestinian landholders have faced repeated encroachment by Israeli settlers in recent years.

title: Israeli settlers establish outpost on Palestinian land near Hebron
